gao-gaoreports-gao-08-62r: A 2007 Government Accountability Office correspondence tracking how the Defense Department has handled program manager empowerment and accountability — the idea that the people running huge weapons programs need real authority and real consequences. GAO reviews DOD's actions against earlier recommendations and grades whether program managers now have the power and oversight the Pentagon promised. The verdict: progress, with more work ahead.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-202r: A 2007 Government Accountability Office report applying agreed-upon procedures to the Highway Trust Fund's excise taxes. Rather than a full audit, GAO ran a set of specific tests — agreed on with requesters — on the fuel and related taxes that pay for the nation's roads. The report records what the procedures found about collections, giving Congress a focused check on the fund's revenue stream.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-172r: GAO wrote Congress in 2007 with good news from the Pentagon's drug plan: one shared drug list plus hard-nosed deals with makers had cut pill costs for the troops' health plan. The letter shows how a single buying list gave the military real haggling power. The result was proof that smart buying could tame one of health care's fastest-growing bills.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-942r: The bank insurer's books needed tightening in 2007 — GAO's letter spots chances to sharpen the FDIC's internal controls and accounting. The findings are a quiet tune-up for the agency backstopping deposits. The letter's moral: the insurer's own ledger should be beyond reproach.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-882r: The FDA's device-review till got an audit in 2007 — GAO's letter examines how the agency counted and split the costs of vetting medical gadgets. The findings test the fee math. The letter's question is fair-play: do the industry fees match the review work?
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-732r: The Library's preservation purse needed tighter books in 2007 — GAO's letter says the Capitol preservation fund's internal controls wanted real work. The findings target the money guarding the marble halls. The letter's point is simple: even history's house needs an honest ledger.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-692r: The IRS's budget-office homework got graded in 2007 — GAO's letter reviews the tax agency's first-year run at the new management rules. The findings check the debut effort. The letter's verdict: a promising start, with the hard part still ahead.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-492r: The nurse shortage needed a map in 2007 — GAO's letter says health officials lacked a method to find the facilities hurting worst. The findings demand a real yardstick for need. The letter's logic is plain: you cannot staff what you cannot locate.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-662r: The troops' body armor had issues in 2007 — GAO's letter digs into the Army and Marines' vest systems. The findings examine the plates and the problems. The letter's stakes could not be higher: the gear between a soldier and a bullet.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-482r: The SEC's own books needed tightening in 2007 — GAO's letter says the market cop's accounting and operations wanted real fixes. The findings target the internal controls in detail. The letter's irony: the regulator of honest books had to mind its own.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-552r: Vieques was still cleaning up the Navy's mess in 2007 — GAO's letter reviews the environmental cleanup of the former island ranges. The findings track the remediation work. The letter keeps the promise visible: the bombing range becomes a safe home again.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-472r: The reserve officers' books got audited in 2007, and GAO's letter reviews the association's financial statements for the year. The findings deliver the formal opinion for the record. The letter shows the citizen-soldiers' group faces the same ledger as everyone else.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-372r: The Pentagon's officer data was shaky in 2007, and GAO's letter says the numbers on commissioning programs could not be trusted. The findings demand a thorough cleanup of the records. The letter's logic is plain: you cannot manage officers you cannot count.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-322r: The Legion of Valor's ledgers got checked in 2007, and GAO's letter audits the heroes' organization's financial statements. The findings deliver the formal opinion. The letter proves valor earns honor, not exemption from the audit. The heroes got their honest books.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-382r: America's passenger trains needed a national plan in 2007, and GAO's letter highlights the case for a policy to maximize the public's benefit. The findings make the pitch. The letter argues that the rails deserved a strategy, not just subsidies. The trains needed a destination.
